chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Safwan, from Aban, from 'Abd al-Karim ibn 'Amr, who said:

'Abd al-Karim said: I asked Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a man who had intercourse with his slave-girl while she was menstruating. He said: 'He should seek Allah's forgiveness.' 'Abd al-Karim said: 'But the people say that half a dinar or a dinar is due from him.' So Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said: 'Then let him give charity to ten needy persons.'

Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, may Allah have mercy on him, said: The way to reconcile these reports is that we interpret intercourse, when it occurs at the beginning of menstruation, as requiring a dinar; if it is in the middle, half a dinar; and if it is at the end, a quarter of a dinar. Sometimes its value may equal the amount of charity to ten needy persons, and whenever one is unable to do that, charity to one needy person sufficient to satisfy his hunger will suffice, so that the reports may be harmonized. And that which indicates this detail is what follows.

key_terms.دِينَارٌ: a dinar as an expiatory amount
key_terms.نِصْفُ دِينَارٍ: half a dinar as an expiatory amount

ai.seo_question: What kaffarah is due for intercourse during menstruation according to Shia hadith in al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This report discusses the kaffarah for a man who has intercourse with a menstruating woman, presenting narrations that mention seeking forgiveness and giving charity. Shaykh al-Tusi then reconciles the reports by assigning different amounts according to the stage of menstruation and allowing a reduced charitable substitute in case of inability.
